title: LaTeX source and verification code for the paper Superlinear Wire Lower Bounds toward P versus NP
description: Source, figures and verification programs of the paper Superlinear Wire Lower Bounds toward P versus NP. The paper surveys the P versus NP problem and proves that the satisfying inputs of circuits whose gates are arbitrary functions of at most s^{4/5} inputs or threshold, exact, modular and symmetric gates with weights of at most s^{2/3} bits can be counted in time 2^{O(s/sqrt(log s))}, and that a language in E^NP needs more than cN sqrt(log N) wires in such circuits. The program code/check_encoding.py checks the finite statements exactly (27 checks). The P versus NP problem remains open.
